videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: When Rebecca's sister Susan visits, Sam discovers that the sisters have been enemies for years, and he schemes to exploit the jealousy they have for each other to get dates with them both.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
videos.description: The brothers fight when Ray has to face up to failure for once while Robert is promoted to lieutenant.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
videos.description: Ray runs into a girl who he disrespected when they dated in high school and ends up regretting an apology.

videos.title: Frasier
videos.description: Frasier loses his cool when he finds out a rival radio host is stealing both his ratings and his agent.

videos.title: Frasier
videos.description: Frasier intervenes when his father is belittled by his supervisor while working nights as a security guard, and a love-sick Roz regales Niles and Daphne with stories about her new boyfriend.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Homer and Grampa take to the road to sell Grampa's miracle passion potion, but old resentments resurface between father and son when they pass by their old house, and Bart and Milhouse wonder where all the grown-ups have gone.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: When Homer is barred from Moe's he visits an airport bar where he is mistaken for a pilot. The airline offers him free tickets if he promises not to tell anyone that they almost let him fly a plane, but Marge freaks out on the plane, and it's up to psychoanalyst Dr Zweig to explain why.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Homer becomes a member of the Stonecutters secret society. He has to start at the bottom as Number 908, but then Number 1 sees something on Homer's bottom.

videos.title: Secret Headquarters
videos.description: A kid discovers the secret headquarters of a powerful superhero hidden beneath his home and must defend it with his group of friends when villains attack.

videos.title: Four in a Bed
videos.description: This week's competition kicks off at Redmire Village Pub in North Yorkshire, where hosts Kerrie and Vickie hope the cosy vibes and stunning countryside setting will be a hit. But some bland decor ends up taking centre stage at feedback time.

videos.title: Four in a Bed
videos.description: People-pleaser Hollie and people-distruster Ben reckon their plush self-catering flats in the heart of the town centre will go down a storm. But the lack of free parking proves problematic.

videos.title: Four in a Bed
videos.description: Tabitha and Steve host the third visit of the competition at Copper Beech Glamping in Staffordshire. They've got a 'relax and recharge' ethos at their glampsite, with a tranquil rural setting and luxurious outdoor hot tubs.

videos.title: Four in a Bed
videos.description: The week's final visit is to Berkshire, where Ana and Dominic hope their homely pub, The Bull Inn, will charm the B&Bers with its quintessential character. First impressions are fantastic. But talk of the looming payment day raises tensions.

videos.title: Four in a Bed
videos.description: Payment day's sure to be a spicy affair this time around, with high emotions, awkward exchanges and plenty of pernickety comments to unpick. When the dust settles, who'll win the week?

videos.title: The Great British Bake Off
videos.description: The finalists make citrus celebration cakes, crème brûlée doughnuts and a tribute to iconic British landscapes. Who'll be the zest and be crowned the series winner?

videos.title: Men in Black
videos.description: Working for a highly funded yet unofficial government agency, Kay and Jay are the Men in Black, providers of immigration services and regulators of all things alien on Earth. While investigating a series of unregistered close encounters, the MIB agents uncover the deadly plot of an intergalactic terrorist who is on a mission to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies currently in residence in New York City.

videos.title: Channel 4 News
videos.description: Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

videos.title: Alpine Train at Christmas
videos.description: A festive ride on the 'Bernina Express', one of the most picturesque trains in the world, beginning in Chur, the oldest town in Switzerland, and travelling through the Alpine landscape to the town of Tirano in Italy.

videos.title: Griff Across the Alps
videos.description: In Bavaria, Griff goes sky high in a hot-air balloon for a bird's-eye view of the Alps. Back on the ground, he visits the Schneeferner Glacier on Zugspitz, before climbing to the very top of Germany. There's also some violin-making and lederhosen.

videos.title: Formula 1
videos.description: Lee McKenzie and Billy Monger present Qualifying under the lights at Lusail. The titles may have been decided, but pole will be vital as Verstappen, Russell and Hamilton fight for second.

videos.title: The Northman
videos.description: Prince Amleth is on the verge of becoming a man when his father is brutally murdered by his uncle, who kidnaps the boy's mother. Two decades later, Amleth is now a Viking who's on a mission to save his mother, kill his uncle and avenge his father.

videos.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
videos.description: Gordon Ramsay continues his travels across the United States in a bid to save failing restaurants from disaster. This week, Gordon visits beachside restaurant Barefoot Bob's in Hull, Massachusetts, owned by husband-and-wife team Marc and Lisa. The duo opened the grill in the summer of 2004 to a busy seafront crowd, but every year the bottom line collapses through the bleak winter months.

videos.title: The Dog House
videos.description: Patch the Border Collie displays an impressive array of tricks to try to convince horse-groomer Megan that he's a smart choice. Pebbles the Lhasa is a sofa addict and a bit on the chunky side, she's matched with David, a Paralympian and workaholic.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Bart damages Australian-American relations when a prank phone call goes awry, and must travel down under to receive his punishment.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Springfield launches a film festival and `Pocahontas', Barney's haunting meditation on his alcoholism, is on course to win. However, panellist Homer prefers Hans Moleman's `Man Getting Hit by Football'.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Marge starts up a new women-only gym in Springfield and Homer frets about losing her after she becomes a highly successful businesswoman. Meanwhile, Coolsville, a new comic bookshop, opens up in Springfield and puts Comic Book Guy out of business.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Milhouse is forced to toughen up when he learns his parents are lost at sea. Meanwhile, Homer's lack of romantic zeal becomes a problem.

videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: One of Frasier's colleagues, Dr Lawrence Crandall, is in town on a tour with his wife to promote his book on marital fidelity, but Rebecca thinks he makes a pass at her during a private conversation.

videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: Rebecca fears for her sanity because of the erotic dreams she's been having about Sam. When he finds this out, Sam tries to turn the fantasy into a reality by being there in the flesh when she falls asleep.

videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: Rebecca quickly forgets about Sam after she agrees to go to California with multi-millionaire Robin Colcord. He takes her on his private jet to several cities on the West Coast, lavishes her with expensive things, and pampers her with spas.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
videos.description: Robert is seeing a 22-year-old girl, and Debra and Marie think he's being foolish, but Ray and Frank aren't so sure. But she may not really be 22.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
videos.description: Debra's parents come round for Thanksgiving dinner. Debra's so pleased that they're not like Frank and Marie.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
videos.description: Ray can't help but enjoy the extra attention his mother lavishes on him when he feels under the weather.

videos.description: Ramsay tries to revamp a gastropub located in Oak Park, Calif.; Rob Gronkowski stops by the restaurant as a decoy.

videos.description: Filming deep undercover, Dispatches exposes the people smugglers who offer high-end services to migrants who are hoping to travel to the UK, with doctors who are prepared to use Botox, fillers and even surgery to change migrants' faces.

videos.title: Sunday Brunch
videos.description: Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.' Each installment finds Simon and Tim cooking in the kitchen, accompanied by that week's celebrity guests. Other segments include interviews and highlights from television and film, an expert who assists with drink tasting, a round-up of what is trendy, and the ever-popular `Sunday Brunch Playlist,' which consists of music videos chosen by the presenters and their guests. Guests have included Stacey Solomon, Lisa Faulkner, Tara Reid, Rufus Wainwright and Marina Diamandis.

videos.title: Hollyoaks: Omnibus
videos.description: Warren tries his best to support Mercedes, but his scorned ex-girlfriend is never far away. Guilt consumes one resident. Frankie opens up about her past. Sienna, Dodger and the McQueens step in to help new mum Cleo finally get the support she needs.

videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: Norm takes on extra staff to help at his decorating business, but he has such a soft touch with the workforce that they start taking advantage of him. Meanwhile, Sam sells his beloved corvette in hope of regaining possession of Cheers.
